subject: Quick parcel favor?
text: Hey there, I wanted to check in about the parcel that's meant to land on my porch tomorrow. My usual afternoon run just fell through because an unanticipated expense popped up, and I have to duck out early to sort it at the office. The package is small enough that it won't weigh you down, but it's a touch awkward because it has a fragile part inside. If you're free around three, could you grab it from the driver for me and pop it in your car? I'll swing by your place around six, and I'll bring the little container of cookies you liked last time so you don't think I'm just dumping it on you. If that timing is a hassle, no sweat; tomorrow evening after seven works too, or Thursday morning before work. I can leave it at your front step, just text me when it's sorted. Thanks for having my back, you're a lifesaver. Cheers. I know this is short notice, and I appreciate you being the hero of the day. Let me know what works best. I can repay you with a coffee run tomorrow, whichever blend you fancy most. No rush if you're swamped; just give me a heads-up so I can plan my afternoon without chasing the courier. It really saves my evening from getting sideways.
